title: Dynamic Pathways
description: This datapack adds naturally generating Pathways to the game.
body: The Dynamic Paths datapack enhances Minecraft exploration by generating temporary, interactive paths that respond to player movement. As players walk through forests, caves, or custom biomes, blocks briefly appear beneath their feet, creating an ethereal trail. This feature adds immersion, encourages exploration, and opens up design space for adventure maps or dynamic storytelling. With simple commands and scoreboard tracking, the datapack is lightweight and compatible with other mods. Dynamic Paths turns ordinary travel into a visually rich and engaging experience.
